gre_general.value: GRE scores are not used and will not be accepted for 2027-28 entry.
gre_general.quote: GRE scores will not be used as a factor for admission into the UW Chemistry Ph.D. program for the 2027-2028 academic year, so GRE scores will not be accepted on applications.

gre_subject.value: GRE scores (including the Chemistry GRE) are not accepted for 2027-28 entry.
gre_subject.quote: GRE scores will not be used as a factor for admission into the UW Chemistry Ph.D. program for the 2027-2028 academic year, so GRE scores will not be accepted on applications.

toefl_min.value: Chemistry requires TOEFL iBT 92 (4.5 new scale); a speaking score of 26 (5.0) exempts you from further English testing.
toefl_min.quote: TOEFL iBT: Minimum score 4.5 (92) | A minimum score of 5.0 (26) on the speaking section is required in order to be exempt from further English testing.

ielts_min.value: Chemistry requires IELTS 7.0 overall, with 7.0 speaking to show spoken English proficiency.
ielts_min.quote: IELTS: Minimum score 7.0 | A minimum score of 7.0 on the speaking section of the IELTS is required to demonstrate spoken English proficiency.

fee_waiver.value: Need-based waivers exist, but applicants expecting F-1 or J-1 visas are not eligible.
fee_waiver.quote: Unfortunately, international applicants expecting a J-1 or F-1 visa are not eligible for application fee waivers.

supervisor.value: Students are admitted to the department, rotate with faculty in autumn, and usually join a group in January of year one.
supervisor.quote: Doctoral students are admitted to the Department of Chemistry as a whole rather than to a specific research group. After students arrive on campus in the autumn, they rotate with faculty members to decide which one(s) they prefer to advise their dissertation research.

funding.value: New students get teaching assistantships; most PhD students are supported year-round by TA/RA positions with salary, tuition waiver and health insurance.
funding.quote: Most PhD students are supported throughout the year (including summer) by teaching and research assistantships. | New graduate students are awarded teaching assistantships.

entry_route.value: Most students enter straight after a bachelor's; a master's is not required.
entry_route.quote: Most graduate students enter the Ph.D. program after earning a bachelor's degree or its equivalent; a master's degree is not required for entry into the Ph.D. program.

notes: Applications not admitted to the PhD are automatically forwarded to the self-funded MSACST master's unless you opt out. Statement of purpose should name three aligned faculty.
